meta.purpose: Same-binary refresh of ChainHash and ChainHash-128 at thomasahle/chainhash a0116ea, so the Xeon, M2 and EPYC tabs show one revision of each.

binaries.Xeon8375C: the post's build-release-20260917 objects plus the PolyXOR128 lane's objects (as records/polyxor), with the ChainHash registrations compiled from bench/ (evidence/Xeon/provenance.json)
binaries.M2Pro: the public reproduction's arm64 build (the base of the records/polyxor M2 binary; the post's original M2 base binary is no longer available), same method (evidence/M2/provenance.json)

protocol.Xeon8375C: nice -n 10 taskset -c 16-23; two complete passes; higher bulk, independently lower small
protocol.M2Pro: nice -n 10; three complete passes; medians; gate load1 < 4.5
protocol.both: unmodified SMHasher3 --test=Speed, one process at a time; every start gated on no other SMHasher3 process; whole-machine scan every 15 s discards and repeats a run that overlaps another (none was discarded)

meta.units: Xeon B per TSC tick (TSC 2.900 GHz); M2 SMHasher3 calibrated cycles; printed GiB/s assumes 3.5 GHz
